metrics.analysis_note: 5ms max-channel RMS; dominant-rise and separated maxima are signal hypotheses, not semantic impact counts or perceived strength

normalization: none; gain is in pairing routes

sources.envelope: 33-point sin-in / cos-out, linearly interpolated; gain excluded
sources.origin: Grok-generated audio or recorded studio mix thereof; not a claimed live recording

concept_basis: label-derived descriptors plus reviewed contexts; not acoustic classification

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous live-action scene, fixed close camera with a believable physical sound source visibly moving in sync. Capture bold, physical, close-miked sound with assertive attack, convincing mass and clear texture: fast pressure movement, a decisive sharp transient, weighty mid/low body and a natural short decay appropriate to the material. Strong impact and realistic dynamic range without digital clipping, harsh distortion, cartoon exaggeration or synthetic tones. Three short separated takes of the SAME physical event, with varying force and texture, not copies: weak at about 0.80 seconds, medium at 2.50 seconds, strong at 4.20 seconds. Each take has its own explicit duration below; keep the gaps genuinely quiet and never overlap adjacent tails. Sounds must match what is visible and stop naturally before the next take. No background music, score, singing, voices, narration, chiptune, 8-bit sounds, UI sounds, artificial whooshes, cinematic risers, titles, edits or montage. A transparent ice block on a cold dark tabletop briefly creaks under tension, then snaps apart into distinct real crystalline shards. Repeat three separate impacts with progressively larger ice pieces and greater force, capturing a tight sharp crack followed by short bright granular clinks, not glass or electronic sounds. Before each break, allow about 0.35 s of audible cold ice strain. Fracture peaks at 0.80 / 2.50 / 4.20 s, followed by sharp ice debris decaying for about 0.40 / 0.55 / 0.75 s respectively; leave silence between takes.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA

alternate_use: Use as a layer with the reviewed route gain and start anchor.
For a new target, re-anchor the main onset and audition material/scale; matching peak dBFS alone is insufficient.
avoid_when: A crop carrying several audible events must not be repeated once per hit.
Source-specific rejected contexts are not automatically reusable.

intensity_profile.note: Generation order does not determine intensity. These are reviewed usage levels and separate signal measurements, not a universal perceptual ranking.
